title: FinFlow
description: A savings app designed to change how India's salaried middle class thinks about money.

hero.headline: A savings app that changes how India thinks about money.

paragraphs: Millions of working Indians earn a modest salary every month — and spend most of it within days of payday. Not because they lack discipline, but because they lack a system.
A client approached me to design a mobile application that doesn't just track money, but changes how people think about money.
overview.quote: The problem isn't income. The problem is behavior. People need a gentle system that builds saving as a habit — not a burden.

process.heading: Discover. Define. Design. Deliver.
process.description: I used FigmaMake and Claude AI to accelerate UI generation — allowing me to explore more design directions, iterate faster, and focus energy on the UX decisions that matter most.

phases.title: Discover
phases.description: AI-assisted research via Manus AI. Behavioral analysis & competitor audit of India's fintech landscape.

phases.title: Define
phases.description: Identified core user pain points. Defined product goals, user personas, and feature priorities.

phases.title: Design
phases.description: Wireframes in Figma. High-fidelity UI with FigmaMake & Claude AI. 50+ screens across 5 modules.

phases.title: Deliver
phases.description: Full screen designs, design system, and developer-ready Figma handoff for engineering teams.

applications.heading: Every decision solves a problem.
applications.description: No feature was added for its own sake — each design decision was traced back to a specific user problem.
